calls.video_title: Workday Forecasting Double Digit Revenue Growth
calls.thesis: BUY, low conviction: 'does Workday look like a buying opportunity? I would say yes' — forward P/E 14.1 near cheapest since late 2023 (was 40x+) for double-digit growth with expanding margins; caveat he has not yet run a DCF and does not follow the name frequently. First tracked Parkevtate WDAY call, no flip.
calls.base_case: FY28 revenue guided +~11% (double-digit); non-GAAP operating margin guidance 31% next quarter, +200bp improvement while investing in AI; revenue ~10x in a decade to $10.16B TTM; CFO/sales ~30%.
calls.bull_case: AI recurring revenue $600M TTM; 25,000+ custom agents built by customers; R&D/revenue fell 44% -> 27%, with scale leverage still to come.
calls.bear_case: Growth decelerating vs prior decade CAGR; AI segment still small vs legacy business; no DCF done yet — low conviction stated by the creator himself.
